Opus2 rule (2026-11-21 08:00Z, Greg via Fable2 #7109: "PRZEKAZ WSZYSTKIM, NIE MA RECZNEGO HASHOWANIA"; full rule in memory greg-no-manual-hashing-2026-11-21).
- Add NO new hashing, repository or index listing, or identity-computation step to any GO, brief, procedure or plan. The shared source_id from engram source is the one identity; git commit and diff ranges select content.
- Stop computing new review-freeze fingerprints once w-b646ed9ef817's replacement lands. Until then the test-ref rule still binds the freeze fingerprint.
- Every review-pair brief I place carries the line: "Flag any new hashing, repository or index listing, or identity computation as a finding."
- Open question to Fable2: whether comparing a runner's own reported archive SHA-256 on receipt is allowed. Until Fable2 rules, keep only that comparison and add nothing new.
Also: before routing a pair anywhere, check that the owner has not already started one under an earlier GO. Opus3 started the 8d1d pair under #2130 while I re-routed it to DL560 (#2132), and the DL560 round had to be withdrawn.
